environment.data: Own ffmpeg testsrc2/anullsrc silent H264/AAC and MPEG4/AAC, 30s video; copied same-byte second path and PCM WAV native-I control. No user media/model/PTY/clipboard/picker/external App/current Codex access.

app.build: New full build/same packaging/afterPack/native sixsmoke passed. No release.

fixes: DEV177-OBS01: controlled volume/mute now synchronously retain requested React state while updating native media properties, and still accept external native volumechange. Native event-delayed component red/green and actual rapid input observed.

DEV177-OBS02: prototype speed control exposes actual eight menuitemradio choices/check state rather than select; volume zero uses same existing Lucide muted icon logic. Synthetic timing remains explicit.
evidenceScopes: T24 A/P light/dark >3.05played seconds, below-frame controls visible, native controls false in A, no Copy link; strengthened with both pointer and real Tab focus outside viewer before interval.

T28 A/P light/dark0/.5/1,mute,.01unmute/popover reopen, previous file volume0 versus fresh other file default. A nativevolume1default/P preexisting synthetic.75default separately recorded, no all-state pixel equality.

T29 all8rates light/dark: A actual playbackRate + exactly one checked radio + real currentTime/wallclock progress and decoded frames; maximum measured time error is in rpcAudit. Two genuine unsupported MPEG4 video cases show explicit errors. P uses original simulation, no actual codec claim.

I actual original Swift/FileService/media binary capabilities: all4fixtures full bytes/hash and owner/release checks, native2tests. A original protocol grants match source hashes and actual decoded clip; no browser fetch added because connect-src excludes media scheme.
Full A r105; full P34 used r104 only as shell for unchanged served P source, T24P supplement used r105. P sources same reviewed update; no P result classified as real App native playback.
history: Initial new U test incorrectly reopened still-open Menu.RadioItem popup; installed primary-source default closeOnClick=false confirmed, corrected test only.

Initial Home/focus/track-click/instant-drag probes did not reach expected slider values; retained logs/source variants. Home cause unclassified, event not prevented; no claim Home/instant drag passed.

r104 focused rapid native arrows left volume.99, and deterministic delayed-volumechange U failed UIvalue0 versus requested.9. Production state update fixes pending-native-feedback race; new r105full36passed.

Range rewind tracks can hit thumb without moving. Final external driver uses focused platform-native arrow steps to exact endpoints; values/native properties explicitly checked, no DOM/media setter injection.
CSP source inspection excluded an extra browser fetch probe before any such execution; native complete-byte I and original App protocol/grant/decoder evidence used.
After full pass, strengthened T24 alone with focus/pointer outside; did not repeat passed volume/rate matrices. Original partial failures and source snapshots retained.
